item.title: Trump blasts Israel's president over Netanyahu clemency decision
item.description: US president says Israel's Herzog should be 'ashamed' for not granting clemency, as Israeli presidency says request under review.

item.title: Trump hopes Iran deal next month while Netanyahu voices 'general scepticism'
item.description: Trump threatens "very traumatic" consequences for Iran if it doesn’t reach nuclear deal with Washington, and Netanyahu, before departing for Israel from US, says Trump believes he is laying ground for deal.

item.title: BNP leading as counting continues in first Bangladesh polls since Hasina ouster
item.description: Leading PM hopeful Tarique Rahman, 60, says he is "confident" his Bangladesh Nationalist Party — which was crushed during the 15 years of ousted premier Sheikh Hasina's autocratic rule — can regain power in the South Asian nation.

item.title: Democrat Jamie Raskin accuses Justice Department of 'spying' on lawmakers reviewing Epstein files
item.description: Calls for probe grow after Attorney General Pam Bondi was seen holding a binder labelled "Jayapal Pramila Search History" during a hearing, revealing a list of reviewed documents.

item.title: India refuses to send poll observers to Bangladesh amid strained ties, triggered by Hasina ouster
item.description: New Delhi declined Dhaka's invitation to send election observers, even though approximately 400 international observers and 200 foreign journalists monitored the polls.

item.title: BNP claims Bangladesh election win as US congratulates party on 'historic' victory
item.description: Bangladesh Nationalist Party claims victory in elections with US becoming first country to congratulate people of Bangladesh and party led by Tarique Rahman on its "historic victory."

item.title: Manchester United co-owner apologises for his claim UK is 'colonised by immigrants'
item.description: British billionaire says he’s sorry for 'offending some people' after criticism from UK prime minister but insists debate on immigration is needed.

item.title: From exile to power: Tarique Rahman poised to lead Bangladesh as PM
item.description: At 60, Tarique Rahman is preparing to take charge of the South Asian nation of 170 million, driven by what he calls an ambition to "do better".

item.title: Global leaders gather in Munich as 'bulldozer politics' stirs concern
item.description: More than 1,000 participants from over 115 countries, including around 60 heads of state and government, gather in Munich for a three-day meeting.

item.title: Yemeni government and Houthis hold prisoner talks in Jordan
item.description: The UN has urged both sides in Yemen to speed up the implementation of an agreed prisoner release.
